scope: Bounded original default/45 roof reference preparation. No art or runtime changes.

coordinate_conventions.png: PIL top-down rows; UnityPy decoded PNG already flipped from texture byte order.
coordinate_conventions.unity_uv: U right, V up. Original UV0 exported unchanged.
coordinate_conventions.repeat_point: x=floor(frac(u)*W); y=H-1-floor(frac(v)*H). Apply material scale and offset before repeat.
coordinate_conventions.uv_union_diagnostic: All 64x64 texel centers tested against the selected UV triangle union; repeated triangles count only once. UV area sum includes overlapping sheets and is not world/screen area.

layout_findings.type: Whole-image straw tiles with graded alpha silhouettes, not the two-region wood_roof_d atlas.
layout_findings.straw_roof: Opaque and fringe materials share the same complete image. The alpha silhouette is densest through the horizontal middle with ragged fibers toward both top and bottom.
layout_findings.straw_roof_corner: Separate whole-image corner silhouette, with cutout margins on all four sides, rounded upper silhouette and ragged lower fibers.
layout_findings.uv_subdivision: Default/45 fringe sheets divide UVs at U=0.5 and V=0.372882992. These are mesh subdivisions of the same continuous image, not different atlas surfaces.
layout_findings.uv_subdivision_topdown: V=0.372882992 is normalized PNG y=0.627117008, continuous source edge y=40.135488512 at 64 pixels.
layout_findings.tile_wrap: Selected sample UVs stay in [0,1]. Exact U or V=1 wraps to 0 under Repeat. Full-image border behavior and mip alpha coverage still matter.

replacement_scope.material_specific: A SetTexture change on the opaque straw_roof material can use an opaque authored image while leaving the sibling straw_roof_alpha material and original Texture2D untouched. Shared input identity does not imply shared mutation.
replacement_scope.opaque_only_limit: This is a partial visual change. Original fringe color, detail and alpha remain until separately authored and fitted.
coherent_next_fit: Fit a continuous authored straw RGB surface across the full image, retaining vertical grain for the standard roof tile.
Author a compatible graded-alpha fringe silhouette for straw_roof_alpha, using the local original only as a layout guide. Keep the color and cutout silhouette aligned with strand tips.
Prepare a separate corner alpha silhouette and matching corner fiber flow for straw_roof_corner_alpha. Its side and upper margins differ from the standard image.
Preserve saved material-specific mode, cutoff, two-sided normals, transforms and other behavior when binding; do not force alpha to 255 on fringe materials.

Validate original-to-authored silhouettes on the selected fringe submeshes, at the saved cutoff and across authored/compressed mipmaps. Do not copy original RGBA/masks into tracked or released artwork.

limits: Image alpha percentages and UV-union texels are measurements, not visible screen coverage or native shader validation.
Only three high-detail representative meshes exported; no LOD, placement, weather or assembled-roof render validation.
Support normal-map alpha extrema are channel data and must not be treated as transparency.
